name: sql-assistant
description: SQL Assistant — schema-aware read-only and Change Request SQL generator with an offline self-training NLU, centralized learning, an Admin Query Library, schema CASE/DECODE, cross-device schema synchronization (Pull Schema from GitHub with hidden repository configuration and a Secret Vault pull card), a short cross-device administrator message in the navbar, a manual Sync button in the navbar, a CENTRALIZED Admin Password that is synchronized to every device (with a reset to the default), CENTRAL repository access through a trusted repository access service that holds the GitHub PAT as a GitHub Actions secret (no token on any device), a PUBLISHED copy of the repository data that devices read without any GitHub credential, an optional AI/LLM Model, and (V17.7) an Admin Password authority that confirms the default by evidence and no longer ships a browser-test hook, and (V17.7.2) a separate Describe What You Need page for each builder with an honest Result card and a centrally maintained repository configuration, and (V17.7.3) optional, privacy-preserving Usage Analytics — active-use measurement and a hamburger-menu Analytics dashboard that opens only after a centralized, server-side administrator authentication, and (V17.7.4) a serverless Usage Analytics provider: usage is encrypted in the browser and stored in the repository, and only the Analytics dashboard (administrator password) can decrypt it — no analytics server, no cloud credentials, and (V17.7.5) workflows that need only Node and the default GitHub token — no package manager, no cloud login — with the optional services packaged by credential-free workflows.

scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const d of ['build','build-test','dev-dist','test-dist','release','test-results'])fs.rmSync(d,{recursive:true,force:true});if(fs.existsSync('dist'))for(const f of fs.readdirSync('dist'))if(f!=='sql-assistant-data')fs.rmSync('dist/'+f,{recursive:true,force:true})"
scripts.test:browser: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/build.mjs --test && python3 scripts/browser_test_v1773.py && python3 scripts/browser_test_v1774.py
scripts.verify: npm run clean && npm run check:toolchain && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run check:stale && npm run check:workflows && npm run build && npm run security && npm run verify:artifact && npm test && npm run build:dev && npm run typecheck:test && npm run build && npm run verify:artifact && npm run test:browser
